About.heading: About Us
About.introPrimary: Our co-operative society brings rural banking, consumer goods, leading product agencies and a fuel station together under one roof for the benefit of our village. Protecting members' savings, supporting local enterprise and building a stronger community is our mission.
About.introSecondary: Established in 1976, the Panduwasnuwara New Multi Purpose Co-Operative Society has been serving the community for over 25 years with trust and dedication.
About.visionPrimary: To become the leading trading institution providing high-standard business services within our area.
About.visionSecondary: Delivering excellence in co-operative services to uplift the livelihoods of our members and surrounding community.
About.missionPrimary: Our mission is to develop this co-operative into a quality-driven, productive and efficient business by fulfilling the social commitment of enhancing member economic growth.
About.missionSecondary: We are committed to empowering members through reliable banking, fair trade, and community-centered services.
